title: CTIP Experiment Dataset Row
description: One typed IOC feature row and separate three-state target metadata. No model output is represented.

features.description: Only the experiment's declared feature columns; target and evidence metadata are excluded.

dataset_invariants.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate rows collapse; conflicting feature or target rows for one typed identity fail clearly.
dataset_invariants.feature_selection: A uses A columns; B uses A and B columns; C uses A, B, and C columns from research_data/features/feature_schema.json.
dataset_invariants.label_leakage: Target, target reason, prediction window, and outcome evidence are metadata and never model input features. Assembly rejects an identity when an outcome-evidence source also appears in feature provenance; rebuild feature inputs excluding that label source before proceeding.
dataset_invariants.source_reported_context: Preserved separately as feature provenance/context assertions; not promoted to truth labels.
